summary: This is an 8-K filed by Range Capital Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, reporting a $60,000 drawdown from a $540,000 promissory note issued to its sponsor, Range Capital Acquisition Sponsor, LLC. The funds were deposited into the trust account established for its IPO. The note is non-interest-bearing and repayable on the earlier of the initial business combination or winding up; if no business combination occurs, repayment is limited to funds outside the trust. The drawdown supports ongoing operations while the SPAC seeks a target. Watch for any business combination announcement or deadline extensions.
